articles.summary: Achieve 1 million requests per second with 1% writes while maintaining 5.76ms P95 on CheckPermission. The SpiceDB Dedicated product was deployed on AWS with CockroachDB as the backing datastore.
articles.title: Google-Scale Authorization: Getting to 1 Million QPS on AuthZed Dedicated with CockroachDB

articles.summary: Learn about scalable authorization and the importance of building a strong foundation for your MVP's authorization in this informative post. Discover how SpiceDB, an open-source community, can help you build secure systems that scale with your needs.
articles.title: Authorization Must Scale
